name: codex-loop-agent
description: Endless same-session loop for Codex: activate a thread with /forever and it keeps working after every answer using a configurable continuation prompt, with retry, user-message priority, and a stop command.

interface.shortDescription: Keep the same thread working forever with /forever.
interface.longDescription: Codex Endless Loop brings dsh-loop-agent style behavior to Codex. Activate a thread by typing /forever; after every model answer a configurable continuation prompt is injected into the same session so the work continues automatically. Real user messages always take priority, failures retry with exponential backoff, and /stop stops the loop.
defaultPrompt: 激活无尽模式，持续检查并修复暗病
